lines.en: She's asleep, that means we can, uh...
Yes, but we have to be fast.
And you can't make any noise.
Why is the bedroom door closed?
You can't have the S-C-X when you're taking care of the B-A-B-I-E.
You were loud and I was fast.
I think we may have really done it this time.
Oh, I wish I didn't have to wait to take a pregnancy test.
May want to get some more of those, too.
I was in there canoodling you.
I'm sure that Rachel came home early and picked up Emma.
You go look across the hall and I'll call herself.
Hey, you better hope that we're pregnant
because one way or another, we're giving a baby back to Rachel.
